caption: AI planning often yields ideas rather than a plan you can act on. These prompts give you a repeatable workflow to actually decide what matters. Save this for your next planning session and reuse it weekly. Which constraint will you add first to force a decision? #AIforBusiness #Productivity #PlanningTips #naelbuildingbig

slides.title: Your AI planning drifts
slides.body: AI plans without constraints drift. Here are five prompts to diagnose priorities, set input limits, and lock in action.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Analyze backlog [BACKLOG]. Identify top 3 priorities aligned to goals; provide rationale and rough effort estimates in a numbered list.

slides.title: 2. Set constraints
slides.body: Set constraints for planning session: time window [TIME], scope [SCOPE], decision criteria [CRITERIA]. Output: concise plan 1-page.

slides.title: 3. Apply fast win plan
slides.body: Create a 7-day action plan from top priority [PRIORITY], with daily tasks and owners. Output: date-stamped list.

slides.title: 4. Check feasibility
slides.body: Estimate resources [RESOURCES], identify blockers [BLOCKERS], and risks [RISKS]. Output: bullet list with blockers, mitigations, and risk levels.

slides.title: 5. Refine the plan
slides.body: Review outputs for inconsistencies; optimize for speed vs quality; export final plan as JSON.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Hard constraints turn AI outputs into action. Save this and reuse the five prompts to plan every quarter.
